candidates.approved_text: Here's what I do. I don't eat anything until 2 in the afternoon. Then I break my fast with a big salad and I eat dinner in the evening. And here's why I love this. Let's say your number is 2000 calories. If you eat breakfast, a snack, and lunch you've already spent 1200 of them by the afternoon. Now dinner has to be tiny and you go to bed hungry. But when you fast until 2, you still have most of your calories left for dinner. So you can sit down with your family, eat a real meal, and still be under your number for the day. That's the reason why I fast until 2 every day. You can enjoy a big delicious dinner every day and still lose fat.
